entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Latency target relaxed by originator: ~1-2 min end-to-end (check cadence <=60s), not <1 min.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Fire mode: re-arm (not one-shot). PO added 0.5% re-arm buffer + 15-min per-alert cooldown against spam.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Max 10 alerts per chat; any chat, any /gia-supported coin, no /dangky required.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Vercel Hobby plan: Vercel Cron is daily-only -> per-minute trigger via cron-job.org (free, custom header secret). Approved by originator.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Alerts stored in Upstash Redis (Vercel Marketplace, KV_REST_API_URL/TOKEN), NOT Postgres: per-minute queries would keep Neon awake ~180 CU-h/month vs 100 CU-h free cap. Approved by originator.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Least certain risk: Vercel Hobby 4h Active CPU/month (~330ms CPU per run budget). Must measure usage 48h after deploy.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: AC18 pass: window 2026-09-24T15:25:21Z..09-25T15:25:21Z, ~1440 runs; stitched from two reads (run log capped at 1440 = exactly 24h at 1/min): p95 81.2s / 81.1s, p99 111s, max 115s, 0 gaps >180s; duration p95 0.84s. verify.md -> pass 19/19.

reflections.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
reflections.text: Writing implement.md Known gaps surfaced a real double-send risk (delivery log written before fired state); fixed before handing off. Next time: walk the failure ordering of every multi-write step while coding, not only when documenting.

reflections.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
reflections.text: The independent verifier caught a regression introduced while fixing its own finding (backoff vs AC13). Next time: when a fix changes retry/timing semantics, re-read the exact AC wording before coding it.

reflections.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
reflections.text: The post-deploy check was scheduled for +24h with no immediate liveness check, so a scheduler misconfig cost a day. Next time: every external trigger gets a verify-within-minutes step in the deploy checklist, and run logs record failures, not just successes.

reflections.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
reflections.text: A 1440-entry cap equals exactly 24h at 1/min, so a single report run after the window already lost its start. Next time: size measurement logs with headroom over the window they must prove (or record per-window aggregates).
